descriptorProtocol.accessor: Define an own accessor descriptor and count every getter/setter invocation.
descriptorProtocol.proxy: Wrap the named node in a throwing, forwarding/poisoned, or revoked Proxy. Array targets remain genuine arrays under Array.isArray. A named throwKey limits a getOwnPropertyDescriptor throw to that exact key. A trap that never returns is explicitly outside the totality claim.
descriptorProtocol.depth: Materialize alternating ordinary object/array containers; the root container is depth one.
descriptorProtocol.shapeCount: Use shape-cases.json representativeDocument as the base. sections count n becomes n sections in index order with id section-limit-NNNN, name SNNNN, annotation empty, keyOverride null, voiceLeadingBoundary continue, and measures empty. measuresInSection0 count n keeps only the first representative section and replaces measures with n measures in index order having id measure-limit-NNNN, events empty, and completion {kind:'empty'}. eventsAcrossDocument count n uses up to eight fresh representative-event clones per measure; without distributedAcrossSections it keeps one section with ceil(n/8) measures, while distributedAcrossSections:true fills exactly 1024 such measures per section before continuing in a fresh section. Section i is section-limit-NNNN; each global measure i is measure-limit-NNNN with completion {kind:'complete'}; each global event j is event-limit-NNNNN with duration 1/960, annotation empty, and otherwise exact representative chord/voicing. N fields are zero-padded decimal indices of the stated width. A case's more exact distribution descriptor overrides only this distribution recipe.
descriptorProtocol.repeatCodePoint: A descriptor object shaped exactly as {repeatCodePoint:'U+HHHH',count:n} becomes n copies of that Unicode scalar value.
descriptorProtocol.specialNumber: A descriptor object shaped exactly as {specialNumber:'NaN'|'+Infinity'|'-Infinity'|'-0'|'unsafe-positive'|'unsafe-negative'} is replaced in memory; unsafe-positive is exactly 9007199254740992 and unsafe-negative is exactly -9007199254740992. Bare strings remain strings.
descriptorProtocol.specialPrimitive: A descriptor object shaped exactly as {specialPrimitive:'undefined'|'bigint-one'|'symbol-test'|'callable-function'|'boxed-number'|'boxed-string'|'boxed-boolean'|'boxed-bigint'|'boxed-symbol'} becomes undefined, 1n, a fresh Symbol('test'), a fresh ordinary function, new Number(1), new String('boxed'), new Boolean(true), Object(1n), or Object(a fresh Symbol('boxed')) respectively.
descriptorProtocol.instrumentedCallback: A descriptor object shaped exactly as {instrumentedCallback:name,behavior:'throw-if-called'} becomes a fresh function that increments the named fixture counter and throws a fixed test-owned Error when invoked.
descriptorProtocol.candidateAllocation: Count only decoded-document candidate graph object/array nodes created and attached by the reviewed local candidate factories. Each accepted persisted node is assembled exactly once. Exclude discarded F1 validation values, result/evidence envelopes, diagnostics/paths, caller-owned inputs, fixture materialization, worklists, and reflection snapshots.
descriptorProtocol.eventFragments: For a LIMIT-011 event.fragments record, start from a fresh representative event and, in chord then voicing key order, deep-clone the exact named shape-cases branchFragment into that event field. An omitted voicing with retainRepresentativeAutoVoicing true keeps the untouched representative Auto voicing. Apply dotted-path overrides next and pitch counts last.
descriptorProtocol.recursivelyFreezeInputBeforeDecode: After all fixture materialization, recursively Object.freeze every test-owned input record and array before invoking the decoder; freezing does not authorize output aliasing.
descriptorProtocol.recursivelyProxyEveryInputContainer: After materialization, replace every reachable test-owned record/array edge with a fresh same-kind Proxy. Forward only the named reflection read traps. Every named write trap increments sourceMutations and throws a fixed test-owned Error; success requires no callback.

limitDescriptorProtocol.indexN: For an inputDescriptor indexN key, define exactly array index N on the named shapeCount array. The literal 'throwing getter' is an enumerable configurable own getter backed by getterCallbacks/throw-if-called. An object value is materialized recursively by these rules.
limitDescriptorProtocol.structurallyInspectableSection: Create the exact section-limit-NNNN record from shapeCount, then use measuresCount dense measures, distribute eventsAcrossThoseMeasures in measure order with at most eight exact shapeCount events per measure, and set the first stored voicing pitches length to firstStoredPitchCount using LIMIT-011 manual.pitches elements.
limitDescriptorProtocol.lowerPriorityOversize: For measuresInSection0, materialize the 1,025 dense exact measures first; put eventsAcrossDocument exact events into their event arrays in measure order and, when named, put firstCustomPitchNameCount exact LIMIT-011 pitch names on global event 0. This data is present only to prove the higher-priority fatal wins.
limitDescriptorProtocol.sectionDescriptors: A cell inputDescriptor.sections array is literal chronology. For each entry, id is exact and remaining required section fields use the exact shapeCount section recipe. measuresOwnDataValue replaces its own measures field with that literal. measuresCount creates that many dense exact empty measures. A measures array is materialized in listed order: false stays false; an object becomes an exact measure with its listed id and events. measureEventArrayLengths creates one exact measure per listed length and fills its dense events with fresh shapeCount event clones and globally unique event-limit-NNNNN IDs. Event false stays false. An event object with template representative event is a fresh clone with the next unique event-limit ID; apply activation through shape-cases activationProtocol, then recursively apply overrides as own-field replacements.
limitDescriptorProtocol.event0: After a shapeCount eventsAcrossDocument graph is built, apply event0 activation and customPitchNameCount/storedPitchCount using LIMIT-011 element protocols to global event index 0.
limitDescriptorProtocol.rawEventSlotCount: Assert, but do not synthesize from, the sum of materialized event-array lengths; mismatch is a fixture materialization failure.

seededReplayProtocol.transition: one nextUint32 call applies state=(state^(state<<13))>>>0, then state=(state^(state>>>17))>>>0, then state=(state^(state<<5))>>>0, and returns exactly that one final unsigned state; intermediate states are never emitted
seededReplayProtocol.selection: collect all checked-in case IDs matching a seed's prefixes except the exact excludedCaseIds, in lexical order, then Fisher-Yates shuffle from i=n-1 down to 1 using j=nextUint32%(i+1)

excludedCaseIds.reason: internal depth-preflight near-miss intentionally has no asserted public shape result

seededReplayProtocol.expectationPolicy: Seeds schedule checked-in cases and cells only; they never generate expected values.
seededReplayProtocol.caseMaterialization: Materialize all atomic cells for one scheduled case in the companion shape-cases.json materializationProtocol order. For an adversarial case, an explicit cellExpansion is exhaustive and the defaults do not run; otherwise use these defaults. Ordinary inputs, cells, ownKeys, and values arrays are independent fresh cells in checked-in order. F2-HOST-001 is path-major then descriptor-minor Cartesian order. F2-LIMIT-011 is collection-major then count-minor Cartesian order, followed by combinedOversizeCell, preflightBeforeSemanticCells, crossSiblingReachabilityCells, and continuationCells in their checked-in order. A singular inputDescriptor or materialization recipe is one cell. No other adversarial arrays form an implicit Cartesian product.
seededReplayProtocol.replay: For each scheduled case, materialize all of that case's atomic cells in fixed case-internal order. Decode every cell twice through the public operation and twice through the matching private evidence seam using four referentially fresh equivalent inputs. Require the public result to equal the private seam's result for both pairs, require all four result projections to be deeply equal, then verify exact private evidence, public invariants, and all case assertions before recording one projected case observation. Result messages, decoded success values, counters, and heterogeneous assertion labels are verified but deliberately excluded from the digest projection.
seededReplayProtocol.caseObservation: The JSON-only digest projection is exactly {cells:[...]}. Each success cell is exactly {ok:true}. Each failure cell is exactly {ok:false,errors:[...]}, where every error is exactly {code,path}; errors and paths retain public result order. This is a projection for deterministic replay evidence, not the full conformance oracle.
seededReplayProtocol.canonicalJson: Recursively copy the projected case observation with every object key sorted by ascending ECMAScript UTF-16 code-unit order and every array preserved in case-internal order, then encode the no-replacer, no-space JSON.stringify result as UTF-8. Its only numbers are nonnegative safe-integer path indices; messages, arbitrary decoded numbers, and non-finite hostile inputs never enter this projection.
seededReplayProtocol.caseLine: For each scheduled case emit ASCII caseId, one U+0009 TAB, lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of its canonicalJson bytes, and one U+000A LF. Case IDs cannot contain TAB or LF.
seededReplayProtocol.seedDigests: Produce exactly one digest per stable seed. For each seed, concatenate its caseLine records in that seed's shuffled schedule order with no header and no extra final bytes, then record the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256. Store the eight {seedId,digest} records in F2-WORK-001.campaign.seedIds order. F2/build freezes the first independently reviewed seed digests before production conformance is accepted.

arrayConsumerProtocol: Start each cell from a fresh shape-cases.json representativeDocument, resolve every non-null activation through shape-cases.json activationProtocol, then resolve path and clone validElement exactly; target records are visited in checked-in order.

counterSemantics.descriptorReads: one per own-property descriptor captured in a container's single cached reflection snapshot, including the intrinsic array length descriptor and an attempt whose Proxy trap throws; ownKeys observations themselves are excluded
counterSemantics.arraySlotsRead: one per attempted own numeric-index descriptor observation in any decoder phase; it is a subset of descriptorReads and excludes the intrinsic length property
counterSemantics.collectionLengthsObserved: number of recognized sections, measures, events, chord.pitchNames, or voicing.pitches array length values examined during collection preflight; this counts checks, not the sum of lengths
counterSemantics.sectionSlotsObserved: min(recognized root sections length,65), or zero when sections is not a recognized genuine array
counterSemantics.maxMeasuresPerSectionObserved: largest min(recognized section measures length,1025) observed across sections visited in chronology, or zero when none is recognized
counterSemantics.eventSlotsObserved: cumulative recognized event-array slots observed in chronology, saturated exactly at 8193
counterSemantics.maxPitchArraySlotsObserved: largest recognized Custom pitchNames or stored voicing pitches length observed in chronology, saturated exactly at 17
counterSemantics.sectionElementsSemanticallyDecoded: section array elements whose known fields begin semantic shape validation after every fatal collection preflight completes
counterSemantics.measureElementsSemanticallyDecoded: measure array elements whose known fields begin semantic shape validation after every fatal collection preflight completes
counterSemantics.eventValuesSemanticallyDecoded: event array elements whose known fields begin semantic shape validation after every fatal collection preflight completes
counterSemantics.pitchElementsSemanticallyDecoded: custom pitchNames or Manual/Frozen pitches elements whose known fields begin semantic shape validation after every fatal collection preflight completes
counterSemantics.sectionElementsCopied: successfully decoded section values appended to a decoder-owned candidate array
counterSemantics.measureElementsCopied: successfully decoded measure values appended to a decoder-owned candidate array
counterSemantics.eventValuesCopied: successfully decoded event values appended to a decoder-owned candidate array
counterSemantics.pitchElementsCopied: successfully decoded pitch values appended to a decoder-owned candidate array
counterSemantics.candidateObjectsAllocated: decoded-document candidate graph object nodes created and attached to the in-progress candidate graph; each accepted persisted object is assembled exactly once, discarded or replacement candidate objects are forbidden, and F1 refusal/result envelopes, unattached leaf validation records, diagnostics, evidence, reflection snapshots, worklists, and fixture inputs are excluded
counterSemantics.candidateArraysAllocated: decoded-document candidate graph array nodes created and attached to the in-progress candidate graph; each accepted persisted array is assembled exactly once, discarded or replacement candidate arrays are forbidden, and result envelopes, diagnostic paths/errors, reflection arrays, worklists, and fixture inputs are excluded
counterSemantics.diagnosticCandidatesProduced: raw issue candidates appended before exact code/path collapse; distinct independently true codes at one path each count once
counterSemantics.idOccurrences: syntactically valid stable-ID occurrences inserted into the global duplicate index; invalid or missing IDs do not increment it
counterSemantics.idClusters: distinct stable-ID strings with two or more indexed occurrences after traversal
counterSemantics.idDuplicateWorkUnits: one per valid-ID Map lookup/update plus one per clustered occurrence emitted; any prior-occurrence scan comparison adds one extra unit, so F2-ID-003 is exactly 7 and F2-ID-004 exactly 8 and a pairwise algorithm exceeds the oracle
counterSemantics.timelineAdditions: locally valid event-duration rationals added to the document timeline, including events with unrelated invalid siblings; invalid durations do not increment it
counterSemantics.timelineTicksObserved: exact cumulative locally valid event duration in PPQ-960 integer ticks, saturated only at 960000001; exact ceiling is 960000000 and the one-tick-over witness is 960000001
counterSemantics.getterCallbacks: own accessor getter or setter callbacks observed by fixture instrumentation
counterSemantics.propertyGetCallbacks: Proxy get-trap callbacks caused by direct or indirect property reads
counterSemantics.prototypeCallbacks: getPrototypeOf traps, inherited getters, methods, or other prototype callbacks observed by fixture instrumentation
counterSemantics.iteratorCallbacks: Symbol.iterator or iterator next callbacks observed by fixture instrumentation
counterSemantics.toJSONCallbacks: toJSON function callbacks observed by fixture instrumentation
counterSemantics.sourceMutations: one per recursive input Proxy set, defineProperty, deleteProperty, or setPrototypeOf trap callback, plus one per untrapped input container whose own keys, descriptors, or data values differ from its pre-decode snapshot; a trapped attempt that throws is not counted again by the final snapshot
counterSemantics.stateWrites: decoder writes to application document, selection, history, transport, recovery, audio, persistence, or any other external state sentinel

cases.counterGoldenMaterialization: For a Base plus Overrides evidence oracle, deep-clone zeroDecoderEvidence, replace exactly the listed keys, assert its own keys equal decoderEvidenceCounters in order, and compare every numeric value. The representative input is a fresh independent fixture clone; harness observations are captured outside the seam and merged only after exact decoder-evidence comparison.

expected.digestProjection: result ok plus failure code/path only
